company.name: Kasilam Media Productions

company.description: Kasilam Media Productions (KMP) is a creative media and technology studio combining visual production, web development, and digital strategy to help businesses, creators, and organizations build a powerful digital presence.
company.mission: To deliver high-quality, accessible creative and digital services that empower businesses and individuals to express themselves professionally, grow their brands, and preserve meaningful moments.
company.vision: To be South Africa's most trusted creative and digital partner — known for craftsmanship, reliability, and measurable results — while developing local talent and creating opportunity.
principles: Strategic Creativity — creativity applied with intention and measurable purpose.
Professional Execution — disciplined delivery, clear communication, consistent quality.
Community Commitment — rooted in local culture, operating at international standards.
Growth & Innovation — merging storytelling with digital technology and AI.

faqs.question: What is KMP Media?
faqs.answer: KMP stands for Kasilam Media Productions — a creative media and technology studio based in Port Elizabeth (Gqeberha). We offer photography, videography, audio production, web development, and digital marketing under one roof.

faqs.question: Where are you based and do you travel?
faqs.answer: We're based in Port Elizabeth (Gqeberha), Eastern Cape, and we work with clients across South Africa. Travel outside the Eastern Cape is available — travel costs are added to the quote where applicable.

faqs.question: I'm not sure which service I need — can you help?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Just tell us what you're trying to achieve — for example, 'I want more customers,' 'I'm getting married,' 'I need a website,' or 'I want to record a song.' We'll guide you to the right service. Most clients fall into one of three areas: Visual Production (photo/video), Audio Production (recording/mixing), or Digital Solutions (website, ads, social media).

faqs.question: I want more clients for my business. What should I book?
faqs.answer: Most growing businesses benefit from a combination of a professional website, Google/Meta ads, and consistent social media content. A good starting point is our Business Website package plus Social Media Management or Paid Advertising. Send us a WhatsApp and we'll recommend the most cost-effective combination for your goals.

faqs.question: I'm an artist — what can KMP do for me?
faqs.answer: We support artists end-to-end: studio recording, mixing and mastering, music production, plus visual content like portraits, music videos, and cover art. We can also build you an artist website and manage your social media presence.

faqs.question: How do I book?
faqs.answer: Booking is easy. Send a WhatsApp message to +27 65 970 4101 with the service you're interested in, your preferred date, your location, and a short description of the project. We'll confirm availability and send a tailored quote.

faqs.question: How far in advance should I book?
faqs.answer: For weddings and large events, we recommend booking 2–6 months in advance. For photoshoots, podcasts, or smaller projects, 1–2 weeks is usually enough. Websites and digital projects start as soon as the deposit is received.

faqs.question: Do I need to pay a deposit?
faqs.answer: Yes — a booking deposit secures your date and starts the project. The remaining balance is settled before or on the day of delivery. Banking details (Capitec) are included on every formal quote.

faqs.question: How much do your services cost?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on scope, but here are typical starting points: Landing-page websites from R4,500, Business websites from R12,000, Custom web apps from R25,000+, and managed hosting from R99/month. Photography, video, and audio packages are quoted per project — share your details on WhatsApp for a fast, tailored quote.

faqs.question: Can I get a quote before committing?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every client gets a free, no-obligation quote. We send a formal PDF quotation with the full breakdown, deliverables, timeline, and banking details so you know exactly what you're paying for.

faqs.question: Do you offer payment plans?
faqs.answer: For larger projects (weddings, custom websites, full brand campaigns) we can split payments into milestones. Tell us your budget on WhatsApp and we'll structure something that works for both sides.

faqs.question: How long until I receive my photos, video, or website?
faqs.answer: Photo galleries are typically delivered within 7–14 days. Highlight videos within 2–4 weeks. Landing-page websites in 1–2 weeks, business websites in 2–4 weeks, and custom builds depending on scope. Exact timelines are confirmed on your quote.

faqs.question: How will I receive my files?
faqs.answer: All photo, video, and audio files are delivered through a secure online link — easy to download and share. Websites are deployed live with handover documentation.

faqs.question: Do you support the website after launch?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer managed hosting and maintenance plans starting from R99/month — covering hosting, backups, security updates, and small content changes so you never have to worry about the technical side.

faqs.question: Can I just chat first before deciding?
faqs.answer: Of course. The fastest way is to send a WhatsApp message to +27 65 970 4101 — we'll talk through your project, recommend the best service, and only send a quote once you're ready.
